title: Eliminate stdio child exit race in susi-harness mcp stdio transport test
goal: Wait for stdin request line before printf and raise StdioTransport timeout in crates/susi-harness/src/tests/mcp.rs::stdio_transport_reads_a_response_from_the_reader_worker so parallel cargo runs never hit Broken pipe (os error 32).

reuse.searched: Checked all StdioTransport::spawn call sites across crates/.
reuse.reason: Reuses the existing IFS= read -r stdin synchronization pattern used by the sibling StdioTransport tests in crates/susi-harness/src/tests/mcp.rs.
